color: rgb(33, 11, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Bind and validate
parse_steps() against the pydantic schema ·
bind the {service} placeholder to the prediction's service

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Idempotent by construction
the vocabulary is declarative — scale_connection_pool
to a size, never by an amount. Re-applying a step
already in its desired state changes nothing.

div.style: color: rgb(33, 11, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Execute against the fleet control API
steps applied in order, keyed by action + params

div.style: color: rgb(33, 11, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Verification window
poll the target metric every 5 s for 45 s
ε = 0.02 of the metric's span

div.style: color: rgb(33, 11, 74) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(5, 46, 22) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(59, 38, 6) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INCONCLUSIVE
movement ≤ ε
Chronicler moves no counter

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
DEGRADED
the fix made it worse

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Rollback
replay inverse_steps in reverse order
each inverse reverts the exact step it undoes,
rather than being replayed as a fresh action

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Replaying the inverse as a fresh action would leave
the fleet carrying two remediations instead of none.

div.style: color: rgb(69, 10, 10) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p: evolution_log('rollback') + a variant bred at generation + 1

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A window that showed nothing taught nothing.
Recording it either way would be inventing evidence —
and counting flat as a win is how a system convinces
itself a playbook works when it does nothing at all.

div.style: color: rgb(15, 23, 42) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 700px; text-align: center;

span.p:
no_substrate
GENERATOR_URL unset — Guardian refuses to report
a fix it never ran, rather than claiming success
